author_source: project/Chemical Spillage & Response/05_Safe Chemical Handling Lab Safety Video Part 5/src.py

points.K10: 近视眼镜不能代替防护
points.K11: 防腐蚀：实验服、手套和围裙
points.K12: 强腐蚀品戴长臂橡胶手套
points.K14: 不闻、进通风柜、随手盖紧
points.K15: 大量溢洒：撤离、封闭、报告
points.K16: 专业人员清理，许可后返回
points.K17: 易燃品：先了解易燃易爆性
points.K20: 按规定处置化学品和废物

points.K23: 清理溢洒的材料也是危险废物
points.S2: 剧毒、易制毒、易制爆化学品管理

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a clean lab bench with a few reagent bottles and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲怎样安全地操作化学品。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 护目镜、通风柜、易燃品柜、废液桶四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: safety goggles, a fume hood, a yellow flammable storage cabinet and a waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 防护、通风、储存、废弃，一样不落。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰端着一瓶液体往门外走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks toward the lab door carrying an open bottle of liquid in one hand.
shots.narration: 阿杰想把一瓶试剂拿到隔壁实验室。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拦住他，递上一只带盖的塑料提篮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and hands him a sturdy plastic carrier bucket with a lid.
shots.narration: 小研拦下他：这样拿太危险了。

shots.section_title: 凡事预则立
shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本空白计划本
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank planning notebook on the lab bench.
shots.narration: 凡事预则立，每次实验前都要准备。

shots.section_title: 动手前先判断风险
shots.scene: 放大镜照着试剂瓶和仪器，冒出警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a reagent bottle and a hot plate, with a yellow warning triangle appearing. No people.
shots.narration: 动手之前，先想清楚有哪些风险。

shots.section_title: 穿好防护，想好应急
shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves at the lab entrance.
shots.narration: 穿戴合适的个人防护装备。

shots.section_title: 穿好防护，想好应急
shots.scene: 洗眼器、冲淋器、灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eyewash station, a safety shower and a fire extinguisher, each with a small location pin. No people.
shots.narration: 想好这种化学品出了事怎么应急。

shots.section_title: 稀释酸碱：酸入水
shots.scene: 烧杯里装水，箭头表示把酸慢慢加入水中，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker of water with an arrow showing a small bottle of acid being added slowly into it, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 稀释酸碱，要把酸碱加进水里。

shots.section_title: 稀释酸碱：酸入水
shots.scene: 反向操作的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: The reverse icon, water being poured into a bottle of acid, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 反过来倒，可能剧烈反应、溅出伤人。

shots.section_title: 化学品不出实验室
shots.scene: 门口图标，化学瓶被红叉挡住
shots.prompt_en: A lab door icon with a chemical bottle icon crossed out by a red X at the threshold. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品不得带出实验室。

shots.section_title: 转运用防破碎二次容器
shots.scene: 阿杰把试剂瓶放进带盖的二次容器里提着走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places a capped bottle into a sturdy lidded plastic carrier and carries it with both hands down a corridor.
shots.narration: 实验室之间转运，装进防破碎的二次容器。
overlay: 转运用防破碎二次容器

shots.section_title: 三条暴露途径
shots.scene: 人体轮廓，眼睛、皮肤、鼻子三处高亮
shots.prompt_en: A simple human outline with three highlighted spots: the eyes, the skin of the hands, and the nose. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品伤人，走眼睛、皮肤、呼吸三条路。

shots.section_title: 防飞溅要戴护目镜
shots.scene: 带侧护的安全眼镜旁有飞溅水滴越过边缘
shots.prompt_en: A pair of safety glasses with side shields, with splash droplets flying around the edges toward the eye. No people.
shots.narration: 安全眼镜挡得住碎屑，挡不住飞溅。

shots.section_title: 防飞溅要戴护目镜
shots.scene: 小研戴上贴合脸部的化学防溅护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on snug-fitting chemical splash goggles that seal around her eyes.
shots.narration: 有飞溅危险，换成防溅护目镜。

shots.section_title: 护目镜要有合格标识
shots.scene: 护目镜镜框上的空白标识和合格对勾
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a goggle frame with a blank embossed mark and a green check badge beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 护目镜要选有合格标识的产品。

shots.section_title: 近视眼镜不能代替防护
shots.scene: 老周戴着近视眼镜，再在外面戴上面屏
shots.prompt_en: The older man wearing his ordinary prescription glasses puts a full face shield on over them.
shots.narration: 近视眼镜不防护，外面要加护目镜或面屏。
overlay: 近视眼镜不能代替防护

shots.section_title: 防腐蚀：实验服、手套和围裙
shots.scene: 腐蚀象形图，液滴落在手上
shots.prompt_en: A GHS corrosion hazard pictogram next to an icon of a droplet landing on a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀品溅到皮肤，会造成灼伤。
overlay: 防腐蚀：实验服、手套和围裙

shots.section_title: 防腐蚀：实验服、手套和围裙
shots.scene: 阿杰穿实验服、戴手套，再系上全长的耐化学品围裙
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat and gloves ties on a full-length chemical-resistant apron.
shots.narration: 飞溅风险大，再加一条耐化学品围裙。

shots.section_title: 强腐蚀品戴长臂橡胶手套
shots.scene: 普通丁腈手套和长臂橡胶手套并排
shots.prompt_en: A short thin nitrile glove next to a thick rubber glove that reaches up to the elbow, with a green check on the long one. No people.
shots.narration: 强腐蚀品，换上长到手臂的橡胶手套。
overlay: 强腐蚀品戴长臂橡胶手套

shots.section_title: 看不见的吸入危害
shots.scene: 试剂瓶上方飘出看不见的淡色蒸气飘向人头图标
shots.prompt_en: A faint transparent vapor drifting from an open bottle toward a human head icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有些化学品，不碰也会伤人。

shots.section_title: 不闻、进通风柜、随手盖紧
shots.scene: 用鼻子凑近瓶口闻的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a nose sniffing an open bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要用鼻子闻化学品。
overlay: 不闻、进通风柜、随手盖紧

shots.section_title: 不闻、进通风柜、随手盖紧
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里操作，拉门拉低
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a fume hood with the sash pulled low, wearing goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 有毒化学品，一律在通风柜里操作。

shots.section_title: 不闻、进通风柜、随手盖紧
shots.scene: 手拧紧瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand tightens the cap on a reagent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 用完随手把盖子盖紧。

shots.section_title: 大量溢洒：撤离、封闭、报告
shots.scene: 地上一只碎瓶和一大片液体，冒出蒸气
shots.prompt_en: A large puddle of liquid spreading from a broken bottle on the lab floor with vapor rising, drawn as a simple illustration. No people.
shots.narration: 要是发生大量溢洒，
overlay: 大量溢洒：撤离、封闭、报告

shots.section_title: 大量溢洒：撤离、封闭、报告
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰快步离开实验室，带上门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student walk quickly out of the lab and close the door behind them.
shots.narration: 立即撤离，关门封闭实验室。

shots.section_title: 大量溢洒：撤离、封闭、报告
shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边是老周和保卫处图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call in the corridor; icons of the older man and a security officer badge float beside her.
shots.narration: 报告负责人和学校保卫处。

shots.section_title: 专业人员清理，许可后返回
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员在门上挂警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The security officer hangs a general warning sign on the closed lab door and blocks the corridor with a barrier.
shots.narration: 大量溢洒蒸气多，交给专业人员处理。
overlay: 专业人员清理，许可后返回

shots.section_title: 专业人员清理，许可后返回
shots.scene: 阿杰在门外等待，老周点头示意
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waits outside the closed door; the older man arrives and gives a nod.
shots.narration: 负责人确认安全之前，不能回去。

shots.section_title: 易燃品：先了解易燃易爆性
shots.scene: 火焰象形图和爆炸弹象形图
shots.prompt_en: A GHS flame hazard pictogram and a GHS exploding bomb hazard pictogram side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃品，先弄清它的易燃易爆性。
overlay: 易燃品：先了解易燃易爆性

shots.section_title: 易燃品远离火源
shots.scene: 易燃溶剂瓶和酒精灯、加热板之间画红叉
shots.prompt_en: A flammable solvent bottle icon with a red X line separating it from a burner flame icon and a hot plate icon. No people.
shots.narration: 远离明火、加热板等一切火源。

shots.section_title: 易燃品放专用储存柜
shots.scene: 阿杰把溶剂瓶放进黄色的易燃品储存柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places a solvent bottle into a yellow flammable storage cabinet and closes the door.
shots.narration: 用完放回专用的易燃品储存柜。

shots.section_title: 危险化学品分类存放
shots.scene: 试剂架被分成几格：酸、碱、氧化剂、易燃品分开
shots.prompt_en: A storage shelf divided into separate compartments with icons: acid bottle, base bottle, oxidizer bottle, flammable bottle, each apart. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品要分类存放。

shots.section_title: 危险化学品分类存放
shots.scene: 氧化剂瓶和易燃瓶挨在一起被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An oxidizer bottle icon standing right next to a flammable bottle icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不相容的绝不能放在一起。

shots.section_title: 危险化学品分类存放
shots.scene: 满满当当的架子被红叉，整齐少量的架子打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two shelves: one overcrowded with bottles crossed out with a red X, one tidy with few bottles with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不要大量囤放。

shots.section_title: 剧毒、易制毒、易制爆化学品管理
shots.scene: 两把锁的铁柜，两个人影各持一把钥匙
shots.prompt_en: A steel cabinet with two padlocks, and two people icons each holding one key. No people.
shots.narration: 剧毒化学品实行“五双”管理。
overlay: 剧毒、易制毒、易制爆化学品管理

shots.section_title: 剧毒、易制毒、易制爆化学品管理
shots.scene: 王老师和小研一起在空白台账上登记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the female graduate student sign a blank ledger together beside a locked cabinet.
shots.narration: 易制毒、易制爆，也要按规定登记。

shots.section_title: 小量溢洒的处置与报告
shots.scene: 台面上一小摊液体
shots.prompt_en: A small spill puddle on a lab bench next to an upright bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 小量溢洒，自己有把握才处理。
overlay: 小量溢洒的处置与报告

shots.section_title: 小量溢洒的处置与报告
shots.scene: 小研戴好护目镜手套，从溢洒处理箱取吸附材料
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing goggles and gloves takes absorbent pads from a spill kit box.
shots.narration: 先防护，再取溢洒处理箱。

shots.section_title: 小量溢洒的处置与报告
shots.scene: 吸附垫从外圈向内覆盖液体的示意
shots.prompt_en: An illustration of absorbent pads placed around a spill from the outside edge toward the center. No people.
shots.narration: 用吸附材料从外向内围住、吸干。

shots.section_title: 小量溢洒的处置与报告
shots.scene: 小研把用过的吸附垫装袋，贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts used absorbent pads into a bag and seals it with a blank label.
shots.narration: 收集起来，当危险废物处理。

shots.section_title: 小量溢洒的处置与报告
shots.scene: 小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man in the lab office.
shots.narration: 处理完要报告；没把握就按大量处理。

shots.section_title: 按规定处置化学品和废物
shots.scene: 小研把废液倒入带漏斗的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours waste liquid through a funnel into a labeled waste container inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 用完的化学品和废物，按规定处置。
overlay: 按规定处置化学品和废物

shots.section_title: 废物用耐腐蚀容器
shots.scene: 塑料桶和金属桶图标，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a chemical-resistant plastic carboy and a metal can, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 废物用耐化学品的塑料或金属容器装。

shots.section_title: 不得靠通风柜蒸发“处置”溶剂
shots.scene: 通风柜里敞口烧杯冒蒸气，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An open beaker of solvent evaporating inside a fume hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能把溶剂放通风柜里挥发掉了事。
overlay: 不得靠通风柜蒸发“处置”溶剂

shots.section_title: 不得靠通风柜蒸发“处置”溶剂
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man a question beside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 需要蒸发溶剂，先问负责人怎么做。

shots.section_title: 清理溢洒的材料也是危险废物
shots.scene: 用过的纸巾装进危险废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Used paper towels being placed into a hazardous waste bag with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 擦过溢洒的纸巾，也是危险废物。
overlay: 清理溢洒的材料也是危险废物

shots.section_title: 危险废物分类收集，不倒下水道
shots.scene: 几个废液桶分开摆放，各贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Several waste containers lined up separately, each with a blank label and a different color cap. No people.
shots.narration: 废液废物要分类收集、贴好标签。
overlay: 危险废物分类收集，不倒下水道

shots.section_title: 危险废物分类收集，不倒下水道
shots.scene: 往水槽里倒废液的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of waste liquid being poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不得倒进水槽和下水道。

shots.section_title: 危险废物分类收集，不倒下水道
shots.scene: 不相容的两种废液往同一桶里倒，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two different waste bottles pouring into the same container, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不相容的废液，不能混装。

shots.section_title: 危险废物分类收集，不倒下水道
shots.scene: 老李把封好的废液桶交给回收车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer loads sealed labeled waste containers onto a collection cart.
shots.narration: 由学校统一交给有资质的单位处置。

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤眼睛：冲洗、就医、报告
shots.scene: 阿杰在洗眼器前冲洗眼睛，小研在旁扶着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his eyes at an eyewash station while the female graduate student supports him.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，马上到洗眼器持续冲洗。
overlay: 沾到皮肤眼睛：冲洗、就医、报告

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤眼睛：冲洗、就医、报告
shots.scene: 冲淋器下大量清水冲洗的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person under a safety shower with water flowing, next to an icon of contaminated clothing being removed. No people.
shots.narration: 沾到皮肤，脱去污染衣物，大量清水冲洗。

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤眼睛：冲洗、就医、报告
shots.scene: 电话、红十字和一份空白文件图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon, a red cross icon and a blank document icon together. No people.
shots.narration: 带上SDS就医，并及时报告。

shots.section_title: 准备是安全的关键
shots.scene: 欣欣举着三张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three blank cards one after another.
shots.narration: 准备，是安全操作化学品的关键。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现护目镜、围裙、通风柜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of splash goggles, an apron and a fume hood.
shots.narration: 酸入水，护目镜，通风柜里操作。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 门、电话和警示牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closed door, a telephone and a warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 大量溢洒撤离报告，小量会处理。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 分类废液桶和打叉的水槽图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of separate waste containers and a sink drain crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 分类存放，废物分类，不倒下水道。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的通风柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy fume hood with the sash closed.
shots.narration: 做好准备，安全实验，下次见！
